submitter_note: Mr. Dyck, MLA for Grande Prairie
request: do not remove a seat from northern Alberta, partly because northern ridings contain most of the nations, which need representation
quote: Northern Alberta predominantly has most of the nonurban or very close to urban centre nations, and those also require representation.
note: General northern-representation argument; nations are one reason among many (geography, municipalities, economy). Names no nation and no specific district arrangement beyond not cutting a northern seat. Says his own riding has no nation. 'Samson' keyword hit is Commissioner Samson.

submitter_note: Brianna Morris, resident of Strathcona-Sherwood Park
note: Beaumont/Strathcona-Sherwood Park and rural representation; no reserve content. 'Samson' = commissioner.

submitter_note: Alexander Dowsey, historian, resident of Edmonton-Highlands-Norwood
note: Naming only: suggests renaming Edmonton-West-Enoch 'Edmonton-Maskêkosihk' (Cree name for Enoch Nation). No request about which district Enoch is in. Commissioner Clark says he would not presume on Enoch without hearing from it.

submitter_note: Dave Bilyk, resident of Strathcona-Sherwood Park
note: Heritage Hills/Beaumont/Tofield; no reserve content. 'Samson' = commissioner.

submitter_note: Chelsea Balzan, president, Glastonbury Community League, west Edmonton
request: keep Edmonton-West-Enoch as an urban Edmonton plus Enoch Cree Nation riding and move the Parkland county portion to Stony Plain-Drayton Valley-Devon
quote: A solution to this dilution of representation would be to keep Edmonton-West-Enoch as a hybrid urban Edmonton-First Nations riding, moving the Parkland county portion to Stony Plain-Drayton Valley-Devon.
note: Describes ties between Glastonbury neighbourhoods and adjacent Enoch Cree Nation, but defers to Enoch: 'I hope that much feedback is received from Enoch Cree Nation ... as they are best placed to comment on their inclusion in the majority urban riding versus rural.' Her main ask is to remove Parkland county; keeping Enoch with west Edmonton is part of her proposed arrangement. Also supports possibly using a Cree name with Enoch's guidance.

submitter_note: A.J. Wrenn, resident of Edmonton-North West
note: More seats for Edmonton, electoral reform, likes 'Grand Trunk' name; no reserve content.

submitter_note: Bodda Ammar, Edmonton-Meadows constituency office staffer
note: Extra Edmonton seat; no reserve content.

submitter_note: Scott Sinclair, MLA for Lesser Slave Lake (describes himself as the riding's First Nation MLA)
community: Swan River, Sawridge, Driftpile, Sucker Creek (south shore of Lesser Slave Lake); also Bigstone, Whitefish, Woodland Cree, Lubicon, Loon Lake, Peerless Trout, Kapawe'no; East Prairie, Gift Lake, Peavine Métis settlements
request: keep the Lesser Slave Lake riding as is, keeping the south-shore First Nations and Métis communities with Slave Lake and High Prairie rather than moving them into the proposed Mackenzie county riding
quote: All of those communities that I mentioned that are now in the proposed Mackenzie county are all communities that share and live and work together in a common-sense way.
note: Main ask: 'please keep the Lesser Slave Lake riding as is' (EB-768); confirms 'Yes, sir' to the Chair's summary of keeping 2017 boundaries. Lists 11 First Nations and 3 Métis settlements in the riding. Would accept adding Swan Hills; says Saddle Lake is not tied to Slave Lake. Membership: says the riding has 'a First Nation MLA' (himself) and mentions his mushum; names no nation; speaks as MLA, not for a nation.

submitter_note: Nate Glubish, MLA for Strathcona-Sherwood Park
note: Beaumont/Heritage Hills/Tofield/north of highway 16; no reserve content.

submitter_note: Vladimir Pasek, resident of St. Albert-Sturgeon
note: Woodlands neighbourhood, St. Albert boundaries; no reserve content.
Urban-rural hybrids, downtown Edmonton seat; no reserve content.

submitter_note: Jason Nixon, MLA for Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre (relays concerns of Chief Poucette, Big Horn)
request: do not move the O'Chiese, Sunchild and Big Horn reserves into the proposed Banff-Jasper riding; keep them with Rocky Mountain House in a west-central Banff-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre riding
quote: The proposed Banff-Jasper riding will take three reserves within Clearwater county – the O’Chiese, Sunchild, and the Big Horn – and completely disconnect them from their local town.
note: Says 'I certainly do not speak for these nations' but relays Chief Poucette of Big Horn: opposes any change disrupting the highway 11 corridor between Saskatchewan Crossing and Rocky Mountain House, and opposes the Banff-Jasper riding; letter from Big Horn handed to the clerk. In answer to Commissioner Clark (EB-782/783): the chief is 'very indifferent' about being in the same riding as Stoney Nakoda (Morley etc.) but not open to being disconnected from Rocky Mountain House; suggests Stoney could be added to a west-central riding instead. Record runs into Will van Engen (Edmonton-North West), not coded.
Edmonton-Glenora/Riverview merger, Brookside; no reserve content.

submitter_note: Jennifer Klimek, resident of Edmonton-Gold Bar
note: Gold Bar, hybrids, more seats; no reserve content.

submitter_note: Stephen Raitz, urban planner and lawyer, Ritchie (Edmonton-Gold Bar)
request: no specific placement; asks the commission to listen to Enoch's own view of where it fits, since in Edmonton-West-Enoch its voice could be subsumed by the larger urban population
quote: if it’s the Enoch First Nation or if it’s Beaumont, like, understanding that their voices would be underrepresented in that situation and seeing where they see themselves in that broader community of interest
note: Passing but on point: names Edmonton-West-Enoch as a case where a small community of interest is subsumed in a larger one; defers to Enoch's feedback; no district proposed.

submitter_note: Ms Gray, MLA for Edmonton-Mill Woods
note: Larkspur/Mill Woods, naming Edmonton-South East 'Decoteau'; no reserve content. Screen hit 'samson' = commissioner.
Only a land acknowledgement ('Treaty 6 territory'); rest is about Edmonton seats and Highlands-Norwood.
